symbols.aDeepToneCallsForTheLeftLeverA: A deep tone calls for the left lever; a high tone calls for the right lever. The levers sit beside the circle display.
symbols.aRedBelowTheGridMeansClickThePedal: A red ! below the grid means click the pedal on the same side. The pedals sit beside the W controls.
symbols.aRedLeftLightMeansDownARedRight: A red left light means Down. A red right light means Up. Respond quickly without losing control of the car.
symbols.afterARandomDelayTheScreenTurnsGreenThis: After a random delay, the screen turns green. This is the moment the timer starts.
symbols.beforeStartingTapEachOfTheEightSymbolTyp: Before starting, tap each of the eight symbol types to choose whether it belongs to the good or bad group.
symbols.buildTheTowerOnTheRight: Build the tower on the right
symbols.circleEverySquareMatchingOneOfTheTargetT: Circle every square matching one of the target types.
symbols.dragAMovableDiskOrTapItOnceA: Drag a movable disk, or tap it once. A selected source rises and receives a cyan outline.
symbols.eachOuterLedPointsToTheNumberBesideIt: Each outer LED points to the number beside it. Read the illuminated value on both the left and right displays.
symbols.eachShapeAppearsOnceInEveryRowAndColumn: Each shape appears once in every row and column. Tap an empty cell to make a note, then return to answering to submit.
symbols.everyDiskBeginsOnTheLeftArrangedFromLarg: Every disk begins on the left, arranged from largest at the bottom to smallest at the top.
symbols.leftValues14UseQWERRight: Left values 1–4 use Q W E R. Right values 1–4 use U I O P. Hold one key from each group together.
symbols.noTargetTypesSelectedLeaveEverySquareUnc: No target types selected; leave every square uncircled.
symbols.numbersShowTheOrderStartingWith1: Numbers show the order, starting with 1.
symbols.onTouchScreensHoldTheMatchingSideAndTop: On touch screens, hold the matching side and top circles simultaneously.
symbols.severalSevenSegmentDisplaysIlluminateBri: Several seven-segment displays illuminate briefly. Remember their positions rather than their order.
symbols.squaresAppearOneAtATimeIdentifyTheHighli: Squares appear one at a time. Identify the highlighted corner or side and recall how you classified that type.
symbols.theLightsBesideTheRoadAreNormallyGreenCo: The lights beside the road are normally green. Continue steering while watching for either one to turn red.
symbols.touchAndHoldTheMatchingLeftAndRightButto: Touch and hold the matching left and right buttons together. The response is recorded only when both sides are pressed.
symbols.whenOneOfTheTenCirclesIlluminatesRespond: When one of the ten circles illuminates, respond with its color. Its position does not change the answer.
symbols.yourCarStaysHalfwayUpTheScreenUseLeft: Your car stays halfway up the screen. Use Left and Right to change lanes and avoid passing cars.
